seo.title: Flake Floors Toowoomba
seo.description: Garage floor concrete slabs Call Dolley Concreting Toowoomba on 0409 326 188

body: Dolley Concreting Toowoomba supply and install a wide range of seamless flake floor products to suit your garage or workplace area. Popular applications include garage and workshop floors or simply improving the look of plain concrete surfaces.

It is suitable for floors in either conventional smooth or non slip finishes. The finish is durable and resistant to cracking, scratching and scuffing. Flake flooring is resistant to most solvents and oils. There are no seams and cracks to harbour dirt.
